inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the Royal Sea Scope itself is a shared vessel, run by its crew.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided alongside the complimentary drinks on deck.

Complimentary drinks are served here, and the deck offers open-air views across the Gulf of Aqaba towards the mountains of Saudi Arabia — a perspective that is, in its own way, as striking as anything below the surface.
The crew narrates what you are seeing, identifying species and pointing out formations.
